summary: Keep opt-in named-source Publisher attachment available for incompatible persisted identities and revalidate metadata after unrelated DDL.

replay.detail: No admission, replay, source capture, prepared publication or retained-root certification is supplied or changed.

schema.detail: No schema, index, trigger, journal or persisted counter is created. Explicit attachment reads existing Installer metadata.

rules.detail: No authority, retention, checkpoint, digest or read-coverage rules change.

compatibility.detail: Library-only opt-in attach_with_sources now initializes unavailable wake state for missing or mismatched persisted source identities. Invalid configuration and unsupported metadata schema/storage still reject attachment. No identity is rebound and the default Publisher attachment is unchanged. No production source activation is included.

downtime.detail: Library-only source change; no deployment or restart behavior is implemented.

manual.detail: Adopting source owners retain native capture, full-cut checks and explicit replacement/restore lifetime guards. Identical metadata DDL and root pages cannot certify table incarnation. No production adopter or recovery procedure is installed.

recovery.detail: Missing or mismatched persisted named-source identities initialize unavailable wake state without rebinding or repairing them. Unrelated DDL refreshes the schema cookie only after metadata declaration, shape and primary-key revalidation; incompatible metadata remains invalidated. Source owners still guard replacement/restore and native lifetime coverage. Wake tokens do not restore availability, clear fences or certify historical namespace retention. No production recovery implementation is included.
